guitar.notes: Jeff Beck is one of the most famous Stratocaster players, with his own long-running Fender Jeff Beck Signature Strat; extensively documented.

tone.target: clean singing Strat lead with wide delay and smooth sustain
tone.profile: clean singing Strat lead with wide delay and smooth sustain
tone.summary: A pristine, airy signal chain built around a clean US Deluxe amp model, utilizing compression for sustain, followed by Chorus (if needed for air), and massive Digital Delay and Room reverb to achieve the vocal, singing lead tone of Jeff Beck.
corrections: keep it airy but not modulated
make lead more vocal and sustained
